hypotheses.B0_full_patch_recomposition_is_exact: The independently recomposed full product patch changes every logit by at most 1e-4 relative to the full-patch reference.
hypotheses.B1_frozen_taylor_preserves_behavior: At rank 256, frozen Taylor selection recovers at least 0.50 of full-patch KL and at least 0.40 in the highest-effect quartile in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.B2_taylor_beats_unconditioned_controls: At rank 256, frozen Taylor selection exceeds both random and static-weight KL recovery by at least 0.20 in every cell.
hypotheses.B3_taylor_approaches_endpoint_local: At rank 256, frozen Taylor selection is within 0.15 KL recovery of endpoint-local selection in every cell.
hypotheses.B4_behavioral_compiler_transfers_ood: Taylor rank-256 KL recovery differs by at most 0.15 between FineWeb and TinyStories in each layer.
hypotheses.B5_output_connectivity_matters: Taylor-local exceeds Taylor-magnitude rank-256 KL recovery by at least 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.B6_behavior_oracle_is_an_upper_control: Behavior-oracle rank-256 recovery is no worse than Taylor-local by more than 0.02 in every cell.
hypotheses.B7_ce_effect_is_preserved: Taylor rank-256 CE-effect fidelity is at least 0.40 in every cell.
hypotheses.B8_high_effect_results_are_not_baseline_: In the highest-effect quartile, Taylor rank-256 recovery exceeds random by at least 0.15 in every cell.
hypotheses.B9_orders_and_sampling_are_frozen: Layer orders, random-token edit sampling, ranks, metrics, and thresholds are declared before behavior outcomes are evaluated.
